settings.title: Choose the Right Filtration Technology for Your Process

settings.editor: Whether you handle oil mist, emulsions, smoke, or ultra-fine aerosols, our self-cleaning filtration systems deliver cleaner air, lower maintenance, and stable performance.
Compare technologies below or jump directly to the right solution.

settings.editor:
1. Pre-Filtration — Stainless steel mesh captures larger droplets before separation.
  2. Coalescence — Rotating drums enlarge tiny oil particles into larger droplets for efficient separation and oil recovery.
  3. Self-Cleaning & Recycling — Integrated spraying nozzles maintain constant performance and recycle collected oil.

settings.editor:
1. Stainless steel pre-filter — First stage captures larger particles to protect ionizer.
  2. Ionization — High voltage ionizer charges particles for electrostatic capture.
  3. Collector plates — Alternating plates attract and hold charged particles.
  4. Oil particle collection — Self-cleaning drain removes collected oil automatically.
